messages.author: 62a7fe14c0ce6d79
messages.subject: Extract Regression Scores from procD.lm
parts:
Hello - is there a simple way to calculate the regression scores from a procD.lm (or procD.pgls) object? The function RegScore from morpho does not seem to play well with procD.lm objects.

Thanks
Faysal

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Extract Regression Scores from procD.lm
parts:
You can use plot.procD.lm.  Here is an example

> data(plethodon) 
> Y.gpa <- gpagen(plethodon$land)    #GPA-alignment  

> gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(Y.gpa, 
+                            site = plethodon$site, 
+                            species = plethodon$species)
> procD.lm(coords ~ log(Csize) + species * site, data = gdf, 
+          iter = 999, print.progress = FALSE, turbo = TRUE)
> myplot <- plot(fit, type = "regression", predictor = log(gdf$Csize))
> myplot$RegScore
